title: 第11章 鼠害第12章 横跳引怪法
content_zh:
从机房里出来，时间才下午四点，精力充沛的同学们会在操场上不知疲倦的练习锻体式，如果还有时间，还会进行两两对战，班级之间的挑战也是很常见。
今天方南山没有留下来观看，在以前，他都是观众，各种打架挑战，没有人会盯上他。
在进入仙灵世界之前，大家平时都有练习各种体式的动作姿势，无论是虎形熊形牛形猴形的体式，多加练习总会改善体质，提升人体素质，不像仙界里那样数据暴增，并且有同质化的增量限制。
在现实里，每个体式姿势都是对身体的某些部位的锻炼，练得多就会提升相应的力量，反应。
只有持续练到某个程度，这种提升才会停滞。
根本没有限制你练习的是哪种功法的体式。
方南山只能练习动作舒缓的太极体式，并且时间不能长，他锻炼得多，并不会增加自身，反而是一种负担。
所以现在他最重要的事情，是先修复好身体，达到正常健康的状态才能开始训练。
于是这一天他直接就提前放学，回家去了，路过一水果店顺便买了十斤水果。
回到家中后马不停蹄的进行泡茶，榨果汁等一系列操作。
这次没有浪费时间，一切流程他都相当熟悉了。
【蚀魂茶】【渗骨茶】【黑苦茶】【溃肠茶】……所有负面状态茶水，一律倒掉。有益的茶水或是喝掉，或是装进保温瓶中分别保存起来。
他把家里的几个保温水瓶都贴上标签，相同的都倒进同一个水瓶里。
一口气泡了五十次，有害的茶水出了十八次，有益的三十二次。
其中元气茶出了三次，他觉得还行。
自己喝了一次，另两次保存在瓶中。
果汁榨了十五次，活力橙汁也出了两次，他全喝了。
“居然已经六点钟了，爸爸的电话都忘了接。”方南山停下来，看了下手机，以往放学之后他都会去医院照看妈妈，让爸爸回来做饭。
“妈妈很快就不用再住院了。”他满心喜悦的自语道。
喝了一肚子的茶水和果汁，他丝毫没有涨腹的感觉，反而是觉得全身暖暖的，总有一股气好像在身体里扩散，让人舒服，充满了活力与干劲。

带上元气茶保温瓶，在外面再打包两个快餐，他就匆匆赶往医院。
晚上七点多，他从医院里出来，又匆匆忙忙的赶回家，继续泡茶大业。
一百四十次！
他把仙界里积攒的灵魂碎片全部用光，只留了几个应急。
成果相当喜人，五个保温瓶差不多都满了，元气茶也有半瓶，后面出了四次。
“才十一点钟！我还能再泡三个小时，碎片太少了，明天要加快战斗速度，争取收割三百个碎片。”
怀着美好的心情进入梦乡，方南山不知道，他所住的这个小区，下水道的世界发生了一些诡异的事情。
第二天一早醒来时，小区下面一片狼藉，到处都有死亡的蟑螂，老鼠。
尤其是老鼠们，个个都是又大又肥，像小猫咪一样，平时给大家造成了不少损害，但又始终奈何不得它们，甚至有些已经出现变异，十分凶残，有攻击性。
而现在它们大部分都冲出了下水道，走上地面，却还是没走远，就痛苦的死去，有些还能看出挣扎的痕迹。
小区居民清晨看到这种奇景，都议论纷纷，以为是哪个部门又进行了一次鼠害消杀。
“不会是喝了我倒掉的那些有害的茶水吧！”方南山上学的时候，也看到一些还没有被清理的死老鼠，同样惊讶于它们的个头巨大，以及死状的凄惨。
也算是为民除害，干了一件好事吧。
他没有放在心上，一身轻松的蹬着自行车回学校了。
倒是没有考虑过，如果有些变异的老鼠，没有在这次毒茶事件中丧生，而是适应下来，并且进行了新的变异呢，那这里恐怕会成为变异魔鼠的培养温床。
这是登陆仙界的第三天了，早上依然是文化课，各种关于仙界里的知识都集录成册，让学生们提前学习，熟知，这样进入里面之后，就知道每一步应该怎么做，可以节省大量的时间。
“昨天，全年级又有十七人在仙界里出现意外，进入重生等待，其中有八人是被自己的团队所坑，因为队伍已经度过了最初的艰难期，有人已经有实力杀死骷髅怪了，他们为了更快的成长，获得更多的收益，会暗中对团队中贡献较少的队员下手，制造一些意外，让他们突然死亡……这样就少一个负累，打怪的经验也少一个人分，团队的收益也可以少分一份。”
“所以各位同学在团队中处于辅助位置，作用没有特别重要的，都需要大小提防，一定不要让自己陷入危险的处境中，如果发现自己可能会被团队坑杀，要及时脱离队伍，回到据点保护罩内。”
老师在讲台上严肃的提醒。
方南山心中一动，发现前桌的小包子好像状态不对。

她伏在桌上，一动不动，似乎没什么精神，一大早应该不至于累成这样吧。
“小包子，你没事吧？”他踢了下前面的椅子，轻声的问道。
content_en:
It was only four o'clock in the afternoon when we came out of the computer room. Energetic students would be working tirelessly on the playground to practice exercises. If there was still time, they would also compete in pairs. Challenges between classes were also very common.
Fang Nanshan didn't stay to watch today. In the past, he was just a spectator, and no one would pay attention to him in various fights and challenges.
Before entering the fairy world, everyone usually practices various postures, whether it is tiger-shaped, bear-shaped, cow-shaped, monkey-shaped, more practice will always improve the physique and improve human quality. Unlike in the fairy world, the data increases rapidly and there are homogeneous incremental restrictions.
In reality, each posture is an exercise for certain parts of the body. The more you practice, the corresponding strength and reaction will be improved.
Only when you continue to practice to a certain level will this improvement stop.
There are no restrictions on which exercises and postures you practice.
Fang Nanshan can only practice Tai Chi postures with slow movements, and not for a long time. If he exercises too much, it will not increase his body, but will become a burden.
So the most important thing for him now is to repair his body first and reach a normal and healthy state before he can start training.
So on this day, he got out of school early and went home. He passed by a fruit shop and bought ten kilograms of fruit.
After returning home, I started making tea, squeezing juice and other operations without stopping.
There was no time wasted this time, and he was quite familiar with all the processes.
[Soul-eating tea] [Seagu bone tea] [Black bitter tea] [Intestinal ulcer tea]... All tea with negative status will be thrown away. Useful tea can be drank or put into thermos bottles and stored separately.
He labeled several thermos water bottles at home and poured the same ones into the same water bottle.
After brewing fifty times in one breath, harmful tea came out eighteen times and beneficial tea thirty-two times.
Among them, Yuanqi tea was served three times, and he thought it was okay.
I drank it once by myself and kept the other two times in bottles.
The juice was squeezed fifteen times and the orange juice was released twice, and he drank it all.
"It's already six o'clock, and I forgot to answer dad's call." Fang Nanshan stopped and looked at his phone. In the past, after school, he would go to the hospital to look after his mother and let his father come back to cook.
"Mom won't have to be hospitalized soon." He said to himself with joy.
After drinking a lot of tea and juice, he didn't feel bloated at all. Instead, he felt warm all over his body, and there was always a breath that seemed to spread through his body, making him comfortable and full of energy and energy.
He took a thermos of vitality tea and packed two snacks outside, and hurried to the hospital.
At around seven o'clock in the evening, he came out of the hospital and hurried home to continue making tea.
One hundred and forty times!
He used up all the soul fragments accumulated in the fairy world, leaving only a few emergency supplies.
The results were quite gratifying. The five thermos bottles were almost full, and there was also half a bottle of Yuanqi tea, which was produced four times later.
"It's only eleven o'clock! I can still soak for three more hours. There are too few fragments. I have to speed up the battle tomorrow and try to harvest 300 fragments."
Falling asleep with a good mood, Fang Nanshan didn't know that something strange was happening in the sewer world of the community where he lived.
When I woke up the next morning, the community was in a mess, with dead cockroaches and rats everywhere.
Especially the mice, all of them are big and fat, like kittens. They usually cause a lot of damage to everyone, but they can't do anything about them. Some of them have even mutated and are very ferocious and aggressive.
Now most of them have rushed out of the sewers and onto the ground, but they still died in pain before they could get far. Some of them can still see signs of struggle.
When residents in the community saw this strange sight in the early morning, they all started talking, thinking that some department had carried out another rodent control.
"It couldn't be that you drank the harmful tea I threw away!"When Fang Nanshan was in school, he also saw some dead rats that had not been cleaned up. He was also surprised by their huge size and the miserable state of their death.
It can be regarded as doing a good thing by eliminating harm for the people.
He didn't take it to heart and pedaled his bicycle back to school with ease.
I have never considered that if some mutated rats did not die in the poisoned tea incident, but adapted and underwent new mutations, then this place might become a breeding ground for mutated demon rats.
This is the third day of landing in the fairy world. There is still a cultural class in the morning. All kinds of knowledge about the fairy world are collected in a book, so that students can learn in advance and become familiar with it. In this way, after entering, they will know what to do at every step, which can save a lot of time.
"Yesterday, another seventeen people in the whole grade had an accident in the fairy world and were waiting for rebirth. Eight of them were tricked by their own team, because the team has passed the initial difficult period, and some people have already had the strength to kill the skeleton monster. In order to grow faster and gain more benefits, they will secretly attack members of the team who have contributed less, create some accidents, and let them die suddenly... This way, there will be one less burden, one less person to share the experience of fighting monsters, and one less share of the team's benefits. "
"So all students are in a supporting position in the team, and their role is not particularly important. They all need to be careful, large and small, and must not put themselves in dangerous situations. If you find that you may be tricked by the team, you must leave the team in time and return to the stronghold's protective cover. "
The teacher gave a serious reminder on the podium.
Fang Nanshan's heart moved and he realized that the little bun on the front table seemed to be in something wrong.
She was leaning on the table, motionless, and seemed to have no energy. She should not be so tired early in the morning.
"Little Baozi, are you okay? "He kicked the chair in front of him and asked softly.
